row.evidence: Nimble sells a single plan at $24.90 per seat per month billed annually; its help centre, API reference and pricing page document no SSO, SCIM or user-provisioning API, and users are invited and deactivated by hand under Billing >> Manage Users.
row.notes: New in September 2026. Single plan ($24.90/seat/mo annual, $29.90 monthly). No SAML/OIDC SSO or SCIM found on the pricing page, llms.txt, the full help-centre article list (343 articles, none on SSO/SCIM/provisioning) or the API reference. Users are invited by an admin and deactivated manually (data reassigned; license kept or removed). The public API (Bearer API key, admin-generated) covers contacts, deals, tasks and notes; its only user endpoint is GET /api/v1/myself, so there is no user-management API. Okta's catalogue 'Nimble' app is SWA (password vaulting) only.

plans.name: Nimble (single plan)
plans.notes: sso/scim false by absence (rule 5); the API exists on this plan but has no user-management endpoints.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented anywhere; 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Admin-generated API token sent as Bearer; OAuth 2.0 for the public API. API access is a per-user permission an admin grants.

endpoints.purpose: Return the authenticated user (only user endpoint)

limitations.text: API access must be granted per user by an admin; disabling it restricts all external integrations.

user_api.notes: A REST API exists (contacts, deals, tasks, notes, activities) but documents no endpoints to list, create, update or deactivate account users; only GET /api/v1/myself returns the authenticated user.

okta.notes: OIN 'Nimble' app (last updated Nov. 18 2021) marks only SWA (read from page markup).

fallbacks.notes: Users are added by email invite (c6) and deactivated manually (c7).
